summary: A stone brick fortress featuring a large central cylindrical main building and three tall, square watchtowers. Two towers flank the front entrance, while a third sits at the rear. The structures are capped with flat, dark-colored roofs with stone slab trims and glowstone accents. A low, intermittent stone perimeter wall surrounds the base.

shape.overall_form: central cylinder with three attached square towers

materials.name: slab_stone
materials.role: roof trim, tower overhangs, and perimeter wall

rebuild_hints: Start by laying out a large circular footprint for the main body, approximately 25-30 blocks in diameter.
Attach two 5x5 square towers to the front perimeter and one 5x5 tower to the exact rear to maintain bilateral symmetry.
Build the main cylindrical walls to roughly 15 blocks high, inserting horizontal bands of small glass windows.
Extend the three square towers to approximately double the height of the main building.
Cap the main body and all towers with flat roofs made of dark blocks (likely nether brick).
Add a stone slab trim around the roofs, ensuring the tower roofs overhang the walls by one block.
Place a single glowstone block in the exact center of each tower's roof.
Construct a low perimeter wall around the base using stone blocks or slabs, leaving gaps between the blocks.
uncertainties: The exact interior layout and true number of floors are unknown due to the lack of interior views.
The dark roofing material is highly likely nether brick based on color, but could potentially be dark oak or blackstone depending on the specific texture pack or game version.
The exact block dimensions (radius of the cylinder) are estimated visually and may require minor adjustments during reconstruction.
